title: patchGameView
responsibility: Copies a game document with the selected view patch while preserving other views.

inputs.name: patchGameView.doc
inputs.description: Current document; undefined returns undefined without accessing views.

inputs.name: patchGameView.current
inputs.description: Selected view; undefined returns undefined without mapping.

inputs.name: patchGameView.patch
inputs.description: Fields spread into matching views. No default is supplied.

outputs.name: patchGameView
outputs.description: A document copy with mapped views, preserving nonmatching view references and native map/species/spread behavior; undefined when doc or current is absent.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: Errors from supplied map methods, species constructors, getters or spread access propagate unchanged.
